sources.snippet: Overview SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct is a 1.7 billion parameter instruction-tuned language model built by HuggingFaceTB that runs efficiently on-device while handling a wide range of instruction-following tasks including text rewriting, summarization, and function calling.
